descriptions.d24c_script_start_80100490: Subscribe messages (0x801037a8) and build entries (0x8010391c); read four settings into retained references +44, +48, +52, +56 through a holder cleared before each read and released after each, releasing the previous values; call 0x80100748; if 0x8010273c fails post a string message with the FAIL text; otherwise set the run state to 1, set it to 0 when the flag at 0x804aaf88 is set, and call the handler named by the Initialise text.
